opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and select fastest
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Flights, search flights from {origin} to {destination} (one-way, or multi-city with more legs) for {dates}, sort by Fastest, open the top flight, select it and continue to the next step.
steps: Click the 'Flights' tab
Choose the trip type (one-way or multi-city)
Type the origin city in 'Where from?' and pick the suggestion
Type the destination city in 'Where to?' and pick the suggestion
For multi-city, add each extra leg's origin, destination and date
Open the departure date picker and choose the date(s), then click Done
Click Search
Sort by 'Fastest'
Click 'See flight' on the top result, then 'Select'
Choose the fare option and click 'Next'

instances.values: Multi-city: New York → Tokyo (1 Jun 2023), Tokyo → New Delhi (5 Jun 2023), sorted Fastest

opportunities.name: Expedia car rental search
opportunities.description: On Expedia Cars, search rental cars at {pickup_location} (and optional {dropoff_location}) from {pickup_date} to {dropoff_date} at {pickup_time}/{dropoff_time}, apply filters and sort by {sort}.
steps: Click the 'Cars' tab
Type the pick-up location and pick the suggestion
Optionally set the drop-off location
Open the date picker, choose the pick-up and drop-off dates, then click Done
Optionally pick the pick-up and drop-off times
Click Search
Tick the filter checkboxes you want
Optionally set 'Sort by' (e.g. Total Price)

instances.values: JFK → JFK, Apr 3–6 2023, 9:00am–6:00pm, sorted by Total Price
San Francisco, Apr 2–8 2023, two filters ticked

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search
opportunities.description: On Carnival, search cruises sailing to {destination} from {departure_port} in {month}, then set the number of guests to {guests}.
steps: Open 'Sail To' and choose the destination
Optionally open 'Sail From' and choose the departure port
Optionally open 'Dates' and choose the month
Click 'SEARCH CRUISES'
Optionally open 'Number of Guests', change the count and close it

instances.values: Panama Canal, from San Francisco CA, October 2024
Caribbean, 4 guests (broken up by Kohl's browsing)

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search airport parking at {airport} from {start_date} to {end_date} and sort by {sort}.
steps: Click the 'Airport' tab
Type the airport name or code and pick the suggestion
Open 'Parking Start Date' and choose the start and end dates
Optionally change the sort (e.g. 'Shuttle Time')

instances.values: JFK, Apr 18–20 2023, sorted by Shuttle Time

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route
opportunities.description: On the MTA site, look up planned work or service changes for {route}, optionally on {date}.
steps: Open 'Planned Work' / 'Planned Service Changes'
Type the route in 'Search Routes' and pick it from the list
Optionally open the date picker, move to the right month and choose the date
